en: And of the people are some who say,
"We believe in Allah and the Last Day,"
They [think to] deceive Allah and those who believe,
but they deceive not except themselves
so Allah has increased their disease;

ar: وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌۢ بِمَا كَانُوا يَكْذِبُونَ
en: and for them is a painful punishment because they [habitually] used to lie.
And when it is said to them,
"Do not cause corruption on the earth,"
Unquestionably, it is they who are the corrupters,
